title: SMOK TFV9 coils 0.15ohm 3pack
description: The Smok TFV9 vape tank is the latest sub ohm tank to join the very best of Smok’s TFV range. The 2ml tank is made from hard-wearing stainless steel and pyrex glass and features adjustable airflow for unparalleled customisability. The TFV9 can be easily refilled by releasing the push to fill top cap and filling the tank through the exposed refill port for a clean, mess-free experience. With a larger surface area to heat e-liquid, these mesh coils deliver the most incredible flavour and immense clouds to satisfy every sub-ohm, High-VG E-Liquid fan.
